class.name: CellMaterialND
class.brief_description: Cell material for ND cell meshes.
class.description: CellMaterialND is a material for ND cell meshes. It provides a user-friendly way to color cell meshes using single colors, per-vertex colors, per-cell colors, per-cell UVW coordinates, or ND texture colors. CellMaterialND can be set on a [CellMeshND] resource to define how the cell mesh should be colored, and/or overridden on a specific [MeshInstanceND] node.

members.member: The single albedo color of the material. When the [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_SINGLE_COLOR] albedo source flag is set, this is used as the color of the entire cell mesh. If other albedo source flags are also set, this acts as a modulate color, multiplying with the other colors.

The albedo color array of the material. This may be used to color various parts of the mesh, depending on the albedo source flags. When one of the [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_PER_VERT], [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_PER_EDGE], or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_PER_CELL] albedo source flags are set, this array is used to color those respective parts of the mesh.
The albedo source flags of the [CellMaterialND]. For cell materials, valid values are everything in [enum MaterialND.ColorSourceFlagsND] except for per-edge colors.

The offset of the texture map applied to the base color or albedo texture used for coloring the mesh. This is only used when [member albedo_source] includes [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_CELL_TEXTURE_MAP] or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_DIRECT_TEXTURE_MAP], and only when [member texture_transform_mode] is set to [constant MaterialND.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_PER_CHANNEL]. This offset controls the texture map, not the texture itself. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_offset] property, but is specific to the albedo material channel. See [MaterialND] for how the array length is interpreted.

The scale of the texture map applied to the base color or albedo texture used for coloring the mesh. This is only used when [member albedo_source] includes [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_CELL_TEXTURE_MAP] or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_DIRECT_TEXTURE_MAP], and only when [member texture_transform_mode] is set to [constant MaterialND.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_PER_CHANNEL]. This scale controls the texture map, not the texture itself. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_scale] property, but is specific to the albedo material channel. See [MaterialND] for how the array length is interpreted.

The offset of the texture map applied to all material channels. This is only used when [member texture_transform_mode] is set to [constant MaterialND.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_ALL_CHANNELS] and [member albedo_source] includes [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_CELL_TEXTURE_MAP] or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_DIRECT_TEXTURE_MAP]. This offset controls the texture map, not the texture itself. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_offset] property. See [MaterialND] for how the array length is interpreted.

The scale of the texture map applied to all material channels. This is only used when [member texture_transform_mode] is set to [constant MaterialND.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_ALL_CHANNELS] and [member albedo_source] includes [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_CELL_TEXTURE_MAP] or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_DIRECT_TEXTURE_MAP]. This scale controls the texture map, not the texture itself. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_scale] property. See [MaterialND] for how the array length is interpreted.

The texture transform mode, which determines how the texture transform is applied to the material's channels. Texture transforms are only useful when [member albedo_source] includes [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_CELL_TEXTURE_MAP] or [constant MaterialND.COLOR_SOURCE_FLAG_DIRECT_TEXTURE_MAP]. See [enum MaterialND.TextureTransformMode] for options.
